title: Recording available: webinar featuring Dr. Anna Gloyn
summary: The recording is available for Dr. Anna Gloyn's seminar, "Mining the genome for gold: Drilling down on mechanisms for islet cell dysfunction using human genetics".
bodyHtml: The recording is now available for Dr. Anna Gloyn's webinar on using genetics to investigate pancreatic islet dysfunction, presented on December 14, 2023.
